title: My Daughter's Psycho Friend
description: A devious and psychotic student tries to frame a new girl at school for a teen's accidental death at a party.

title: Girl Fight
description: A video of an assault on a teenager surfaces on the Internet.

title: Beyond the Headlines: The Watts Family Tragedy
description: A deeper look into the circumstances surrounding the Chris Watts murder case includes never-before-seen footage and new interviews with Tammy Lee, the agent with the Colorado Bureau of Investigation who elicited Watt's confession.

title: Guilty at 17
description: A teenager (Erin Sanders) becomes overwhelmed with guilt after her lies to support a friend's claim of sexual assault lead to the accused teacher's suicide.

title: Betrayed at 17
description: A woman (Alexandra Paul) seeks justice when a racy video of her daughter (Amanda Bauer) becomes public, causing the girl to commit suicide.

title: Dead at 17
description: After a stripper is accidentally killed at their party, two rich brothers murder their friend to cover up the crime.

title: Beyond the Headlines: The Elizabeth Thomas Story With Elizabeth Smart
description: Five years after being groomed and abducted by a teacher, Elizabeth Thomas shares new revelations about her ordeal with kidnapping survivor Elizabeth Smart.

title: Honor Student
description: A paroled murderess (Josie Loren) confronts a writer (Niall Matter) and claims that he stole her story while he was a teacher in her prison.

title: Abducted on Prom Night
description: A recently divorced mother allows her troubled daughter to attend prom, but what was supposed to be the best night of their lives turns into a twisted cat-and-mouse game when the daughter and her friends are taken hostage by their limousine driver.

title: Cheerleader Nightmare
description: While flying a drone, a teenager sees her boyfriend cheating with the school's head cheerleader. When the cheerleader turns up murdered, her boyfriend becomes the prime suspect, and only she can find the real killer before another murder takes place.

title: Psycho Intern
description: A young male intern becomes obsessed with a female project manager after they have a one-night stand.

description: Celebrities and prominent individuals cheat the system and illicitly pay for their children's admission to the nation's most prestigious universities with the help of William "Rick" Singer, the mastermind behind the scam.

description: A surrogate mother (Cassie Steele) faces an uncertain future when the couple who hires her dies in an accident.

title: Sorority Wars

title: Cellmate Secrets
description:
S01 E01 — Casey Anthony
In 2008, Casey Anthony was charged with first degree murder for the disappearance of her daughter, Caylee. In new interviews, Robyn Adams shares how Casey lured her into a friendship, and Silvia Hernandez's life was ruined because of the two women.
